name: SVG Map by Smjrifle
author: smjrifle

sections.description:
SVG Map by Smjrifle allows you to display an interactive SVG map with clickable points.

Administrators can select points from the map and assign popup descriptions that appear on hover.

Originally developed under Saedi Works, this plugin is now independently maintained and actively improved by Smjrifle.

Features include:

  • Interactive SVG map
  • Clickable location points
  • Admin-managed popup descriptions
  • Popup descriptions on hover
  • Shortcode integration
  • Secure AJAX handling
  • Security hardened architecture
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.

  3. Use the shortcode:

    [display_svg_map]
sections.changelog:

  • Security: Fixed CSRF and stored XSS vulnerabilities.
  • Added nonce and capability checks for AJAX actions.
  • Improved admin UI/UX.
